versions.description_html:
Learn Azure Data Factory fundamentals, from pipelines, activities, and linked services to pricing and Fabric comparisons in plain English.

Learn what Azure Bicep is, how it compares to ARM templates and Terraform, and how to use infrastructure as code safely with the what-if command.

Your Azure setup lives in your memory, and that's a problem. You clicked it into place once, on screens you'll never find again, and nothing was ever written down.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Bicep actually is
  • Why not just use ARM JSON or the portal
  • How Bicep works under the hood
  • Reading a Bicep file in plain words
  • Modules, your reusable building blocks
  • Deploying, and the what-if safety net
  • Bicep versus ARM versus Terraform
  • The mistakes beginners make
  • Recap and one question for you

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Microsoft Fabric Data Factory - Simply Explained
  • Design an Enterprise AI Factory for GPUs, Data, and MLOps
  • More Data & Fabric episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Data & Fabric: the most-listened episodes
